name: travel_planner
description: Plans a trip by finding flights and hotels, then presenting a combined travel plan.

http_auth_security_scheme.description: Bearer token authentication required for all requests.

skills.name: trip-planning
skills.description: Orchestrates flights_agent and hotels_agent to produce a complete travel plan with flights and hotel options.
examples: Plan a trip from London to Barcelona for 4 nights
I want to visit Tokyo next month, help me plan flights and hotels

skills.name: flights_agent
skills.description: Finds flight options for a destination and travel dates.

skills.name: hotels_agent
skills.description: Finds hotel options for a destination and travel dates.
